messages:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-63421 generated for Northridge Labs — total $3,412.80 (trial + overage). Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-63421

nate (Finance): Northridge says they were on a 3-month trial with 5M included tokens; billing shows overage for month 2 (Oct) and month 3 (Nov). They claim trial credits should have applied to both months.

ivy (Billing): System shows trial credit applied only on Oct invoice, not Nov. Usage lines: Oct usage 6.2M (1.2M over), Nov usage 5.8M (0.8M over). Trial promo set to apply for 90 days from signup 2024-09-15. Looks like a rule expiry bug triggered on 2024-11-15.

omar (Sales): I confirmed we promised the full 90 days in my onboarding thread. Customer relied on that. We should honor.

lucy (Customer Success): Customer is upset and asked for a billing credit for Nov overage; prefers credit rather than refund. They've paused additional jobs until resolved.

nate (Finance): Calculate credit: 0.8M tokens at customer rate $0.0012/token = $960. Suggest issuing CM for $960 and reissue INV-63421 -> INV-63421-R with note "trial promo extension - one-time correction".

icory (Finance Lead): Approve one-time correction of $960. Conditions: add CRM note, tag as "promo-misapply-correction", and route a bug report to pricing. GL: 4109; journal: CRD-NORTHRIDGE-20241202. Keep this flagged as non-precedent.

ivy (Billing): Creating credit memo CM-8402 for $960.00 and reissuing invoice. I'll attach CS ticket and Sales thread to the CM.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-8402 created for INV-63421-R amount $960.00 (status: pending).

nate (Finance): Also please add an exception rule so this customer doesn't get blocked if similar edge case occurs during migration windows.

icory (Finance Lead): Noted. Pricing/infra, please investigate why trial rule expired early; we need an RCA. For now, credit posted and CS to confirm customer resumed ingestion.

lucy (Customer Success): I'll confirm with Northridge and close the loop once they see the applied credit. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
